parts.note: spins about X; ~2,400 rpm at cruise (animate 40 rad/s for a soft blur)
flap L: rotate about local Y; + = trailing edge up; flaps deflect down (negative), 0..-40
aileron L: rotate about local Y; + = trailing edge up
flap R: rotate about local Y; + = trailing edge up; flaps deflect down (negative), 0..-40
aileron R: rotate about local Y; + = trailing edge up
elevator trim tab (left elevator), + = tab trailing edge up
rudder: rotate about local Z; + = trailing edge left (+Y)
tailwheel steering, + = left; follows the rudder on the ground
